title: Hatsune Miku — A Precious Promise〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't it fun to water the tree?
I might go give it some more♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Remember what Ichika said the other day?
It isn't good to overwater a tree because the roots might rot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! I wouldn't want that to happen! So, no more water!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're talking like you're never giving it water again. I was just trying to say maybe no more today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Grow, grow big and strong♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I notice you've been singing lately whenever you water the tree, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know it's only a tree, but I still think it's important to tell it how I feel. Why don't you join me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can I? Sure, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line: Grow, grow big and strong♪
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The tree in Ichika and her band's SEKAI, as well as the one in Minori and her group's SEKAI, seem to be doing well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And nothing like those strange black fragments has appeared for a while.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm still having a hard time believing that such a thing happened in all of their SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Ichika, stop!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Minori, get away from there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Black fragments of feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I knew that the fragments could change colors or even crack and break...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But to think that they could show people dreams...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've watched over many different SEKAI until this point, but I don't remember anything like that happening.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe it's because of how powerful everyone's feelings are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, those trees of feelings themselves are very strange.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even though each SEKAI was born out of starkly different feelings, similar-looking trees appeared in all of them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that the SEKAI those fragments caused me to see are involved somehow...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The appreciation Ichika and the others feel for us in their SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Combined with our desire to see them continue to grow while staying true to their feelings, is what allowed them to come into existence.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Back then, a SEKAI wasn't born because those fragments of feelings weren't able to fully develop into one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perhaps, when Ichika and the others touched those fragments, that's what caused the trees to grow in their SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The SEKAI from those fragments did seem to be born from some very beautiful feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So, if that tree and the trees in each SEKAI are the same, then I have a hard time believing they're bad in any way.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Still, I am a little concerned about those black fragments of feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm a little worried something else might happen that neither we nor the “us” in each SEKAI are ready for.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For now, I'll keep an eye on that tree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because I'd like to help everyone if something does happen in the future.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's see... I still haven't visited Kohane and her team, Tsukasa or Mafuyu's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I should check to see how those trees are doing, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!
